svg.aria-label: Each patch shares one unit of attention across tokens; the cat column is a map; it is resized to 16 by 16 and renormalised, and every layer and head's map is kept: 128 on SD 1.4, 195 on SD 2.1 (inferred), 1368 on FLUX, 1300 on SDXL.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: One head of one layer gives each word one map, and all of them are kept
The heat maps are schematic. The counts at the bottom are real.
Maps each word hands the head
